title: Nine, Ten, and the Months That Are Numbers
label: ch:ge-zahlen-9-10
canDo: I can count all the way to ten in German, and say which words a language keeps and which it buys.

payoff.summary: Nine and ten finish the count, and the chapter closes on the seam the whole sequence has been building toward: the numbers are homegrown and the month names are Latin imports, so one calendar carries both answers to the same question.
